title: Rotten To Beef
description: Rotten To Beef is a simple, lightweight Fabric mod that lets you smelt rotten flesh into raw beef in a furnace.
body:
# Rotten To Beef

**Rotten To Beef** is a simple, lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 / Chaos Cubed that gives rotten flesh a useful survival purpose.

Instead of throwing away stacks of rotten flesh from zombies, mob farms, dungeons, or early-game combat, you can smelt rotten flesh in a furnace and turn it into raw beef. It is a small quality-of-life recipe mod that fits naturally into vanilla Minecraft without adding new blocks, new items, new mobs, or complicated mechanics.

## Features

* Smelt rotten flesh into raw beef
* Uses a normal furnace recipe
* Lightweight and vanilla-friendly
* Great for survival worlds, zombie farms, and food-focused gameplay
* No extra items, blocks, or clutter
* Built for Fabric on Minecraft 26.2

## Why use this mod?

Rotten flesh is one of the most common mob drops in Minecraft, but it often becomes useless very quickly. This mod makes rotten flesh worth keeping by letting players convert it into beef through smelting. It is useful for survival players who want a fair way to turn zombie drops into food without making the game feel overpowered.

## Important information

This mod only adds one simple recipe: rotten flesh can be smelted into raw beef. It does not change zombie drops, cow drops, hunger values, furnace behavior, or vanilla food mechanics.
